_comment: THE TOOL IMPLEMENTATION LAYER of the harness, created 2026-10-01 for bean w2gr. The owner's rulings: (2026-09-30, option A) tool DEFINITIONS stay in cat-harness (cat-harness/tools/ and its discover.ts reader) and this instance IMPLEMENTS them -- the split bootstrap / bootstrap-tools already uses; (2026-10-01) folio-assistant-core does NOT depend on this instance, so the document adapter was cut into a server-free content class that stays in core and a server wrapper that comes here; (2026-10-01) it carries its OWN package.json, like bootstrap-tools; and sci's server half lives in a named subgraph of folio-assistant-sci rather than here. Step 3a moves the standalone MCP server (adapters/mcp-server/) in and nothing else, so this declaration names only what exists (bean dh4f). The layout MIRRORS cat-harness's (adapters/, src/, test/) so that, as step 3b moves src/ here, the relative imports between modules that move together come out unchanged.
name: cat-harness-tools
_title_comment: The HUMAN display name, for the LHS navbar's harness tabs (bean `t3n8`). `name` stays the machine identifier that filenames and `needs` edges resolve against.
title: C@T Harness Tools
description: What implements the harness's Tool definitions: the MCP servers, their tool registrars and routes. Definitions stay in cat-harness; this layer runs them.

directories.description: The standalone MCP server (`adapters/mcp-server/`): its tool registrars, the declared tool groups that load them, and the Dockerfile that packages it. Moved from `cat-harness/adapters/mcp-server/` (bean `w2gr`, step 3a) because it is a server, and the owner ruled that tool implementations live here while their definitions stay in cat-harness.

Tests of the code this layer holds, moved with their subjects so the harness keeps no test importing upward into this layer: `composition-roots` (the declared tool groups and route mounting) and `mcp-graph-tools`.

_needs_comment: It sits on folio-assistant-core, which inherits cat-harness. It needs core because the document adapter's server wrapper (step 3b) extends core's server-free DocumentContent. The reverse edge is the one the owner forbade on 2026-10-01: core does not depend on this layer.
_canonicalUrl_comment: A placeholder base under this repository's own publication root, not a FHIR canonical. It exists because a Tool node's I/O type IRIs are minted against it at load and Zod refuses a relative one.
_name_comment: THE NAME IS NOT AN INSTANTIATION CLAIM. Instantiation is a `<name>.config.json` at the repository root (`harness-tiles`, bean `6n23`), and there is none for this layer. Staged as a sibling directory like fhir-harness; after the split it becomes its own repository and only `livesAt` changes.
